info.title: aio 0.3.7+2de9675196e0dee191c86dc86feadf81c1643b82, AI Orchestrator.
info.description: AI Orchestrator: the loop that takes an issue to a merged pull request, in your browser.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
With no arguments it starts the app at http://localhost:48117/ and opens the browser there.
aio service install|uninstall|status starts it at login, stops doing so, or says whether it does.
